sentences.back: A company makes computer programs.
The programs learn things.
People give the programs data to learn from.
The data is like a book.
The company must tell people what is in the book.
They must show how the program learns.
It is like showing how a child learns.
The company needs to be safe.
They must follow the rules.
The rules help people.
People want to know what the program knows.
They want to know how the program thinks.
This is not a secret.
The company shows them.
If the company does not show them, people may become sad.
They may not trust the program.
Being open is good.
It makes the program feel good.
Everyone can feel good about the program.
This is how companies work now.
